recipes.title: Brown Stew Chicken
recipes.instructions:
Squeeze lime over chicken and season with salt and pepper.
Brown the chicken in oil, then add vegetables and water.
Simmer until the chicken is tender and the sauce thickens.

recipes.title: Spicy Arrabiata Penne
recipes.instructions:
Boil the penne until al dente.
Simmer garlic, chilli and tomatoes into a sauce.
Toss the pasta in the sauce and serve.
